description: Naive unblocked ANOVA (as applied in Arm 1 and Arm 2) lumps inter-block variance into residual error (MSE = 2.689), ignoring design blocking and inflating variance. The RCBD LMM isolates block variance (sigma2_block = 1.631, ICC = 0.536), reducing error variance by 47.5% (sigma2_residual = 1.412) and resolving the discrepancy.

Bartlett test indicates residual heteroscedasticity across treatments (K2 = 14.252, p = 0.0008; Impedance group variance s2 = 2.595 vs Control s2 = 0.902 and Apyrase s2 = 0.563). Sensitivity models with cluster-robust SEs and equal group sizes (n = 24) confirm contrasts and p-values remain highly robust and invariant.
